thesis: The speaker describes his career progression from GE to GE Capital, where he managed a $5 billion property and casualty portfolio with only 15 managers, an experience that formed his understanding of concentration risk. He notes that within the equity portion of that portfolio, they held concentrated positions in public equities, including a manager like Legg Mason with Bill Miller who had 13 years of beating the S&P 500 while holding 35 stocks.
